# JSON Resume Onepage conversion

Manual declarative port of the compact print hierarchy at upstream commit `09f639745d868bcd58cfd26be1a0011bb206f092`.

The port does not copy or execute upstream JavaScript, Handlebars or CSS. Times New Roman is replaced by JadeAI's bundled Noto Sans SC font; JavaScript course-column splitting, float-based dates and page-specific CSS are intentionally omitted. No upstream font, icon or image asset is redistributed.
